final: WITH player_totals AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(CASE WHEN a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL THEN a.g_1b - a.g_cf END) AS total FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.death_country), above_average AS (SELECT total FROM player_totals WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM player_totals)) SELECT SUM(total), AVG(total - (SELECT AVG(total) FROM player_totals)) FROM above_average
